crossRefs.note: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down…
I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies…
When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men…
You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire…
But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”
punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

parallels.note: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

translations.web: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
translations.bsb: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I destroyed those who hated me.
translations.kjv: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
translations.asv: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, That I might cut off them that hate me.
